FAQ.TITLE: FAQ
FAQ.A1: Typically I need about 1–2 weeks lead time for proper onboarding. If critical systems are down (technical rescue or live bugs), I can free up capacity for an emergency sprint at short notice.
FAQ.A2: No guesswork, no micromanagement. We always start with a clearly defined scope. Then I develop in iterative sprints. That means: regular transparent updates, fixed check‑ins and measurable milestones. You always know exactly where the project stands.
FAQ.Q3: Do you offer fixed‑price projects or retainers?
FAQ.A3: It depends on your setup. For well‑defined projects with a fixed scope I offer fixed prices. For ongoing work, complex refactorings or scaling multi‑store setups I usually work on a retainer or sprint basis.
FAQ.Q4: Do you work exclusively with Shopify?
FAQ.A4: No. My core expertise is modern frontend engineering (JavaScript, TypeScript, React). Besides Shopify I also build configurators, interactive UI components and high‑performance web apps.
FAQ.Q5: Do you take over existing 'chaos projects'?
FAQ.A5: Absolutely. Technical rescue is one of my specialties: analyze bottlenecks, refactor the architecture and get the project across the finish line in a structured way.
FAQ.Q6: Do you work white‑label for agencies?
FAQ.A6: Yes. I regularly support agencies (e.g. Shopify Platinum Partners) during capacity crunches or on complex enterprise features – integrating seamlessly into existing GitHub and CI/CD processes.

AI_POLICY.TITLE: AI Policy
AI_POLICY.P1: This policy describes how I use AI‑powered tools in my workflow to support the creation of concepts, copy, design and code.
AI_POLICY.S1_P1: AI‑based systems are used solely as assistive tools for brainstorming, analysis, structuring and general efficiency. There is explicitly no automated decision‑making.
AI_POLICY.S1_P2: The final review, evaluation and approval of all content, concepts and technical implementations is always carried out by me personally as the responsible director.
AI_POLICY.S2_P1: Only data that is strictly necessary for the respective task is used for AI‑assisted processes. Personal, confidential or security‑critical customer data (such as API keys, sensitive database dumps or trade secrets) is never entered into public or uncontrolled AI systems.
AI_POLICY.S3_P1: Every AI‑generated or AI‑assisted output is professionally reviewed, manually refined and evaluated for technical accuracy, clarity, consistency and alignment with the defined project goals before it is implemented or delivered to the client.
AI_POLICY.S4_P1: I value open communication. On request, I will transparently disclose the nature and extent of AI usage within a specific client project at any time.
AI_POLICY.S5_P1: If you have questions about the use of artificial intelligence in our collaboration, feel free to contact me at info@kevin-metzdorf.com.
